thread:
liam: Hey team — onboarding new customer (acme-ml) needs 16 A100 GPUs in us-west3 with NVLink enabled and a larger internal ephemeral port range. Need help opening quota cases and an escalation plan.
maya: Copy. Can you paste the account/project ID and exact SKU you tried to request? I can open with priority.
liam: project: redwood-acme-prod, tried to reserve 8 x a100-40gb first but they rejected NVLink config. Need 16 with NVLink across 2 VM groups. Also ran into "Insufficient internal IPs" in the VPC for the node pool.
jonathan: FYI bigger-port range = NAT ephemeral ports? Which limit did the GCP error call out? ephemeralPorts or VM forwarding rules?
liam: Error from GKE: "failed to allocate ephemeral ports: quota exceeded" — stack trace from kube-proxy attached earlier. Looks like ephemeralPorts per region set to 65536 currently but project limit lower. Also running into vNIC quota (alias IP ranges) when creating nodes with multiple interfaces.
helen: For NVLink we need the correct accelerator type + machine family. GCP support sometimes needs the "acceleratorConfig: enableNvlink: true" justification and expected sustained hours per month. Add cost/commitment numbers.
liam: Good call. Draft justification: "Production inference fleet for high-throughput LLM workloads — 16 A100-40GB with NVLink to enable multi-GPU model shards; ~7200 GPU-hours/month expected; revenue-impacting." Anyone want to tweak?
maya: Looks good. I'll open the case and ask for TAM escalation. I'll request quota increases: A100 GPUs (8 -> 16), internal IPs +50, vNICs +10, ephemeral port pool bump to 120k (region us-west3). Also request NVLink provisioning flag be enabled for these SKUs.
infra-bot: Created support case with GCP: 012345678901234 (priority: P2). Initial response ETA 24h. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/012345678901234
gcp-support-bot: Case 012345678901234 updated: "Please provide business justification and expected usage pattern; NVLink availability varies by zone. Provide preferred zones within us-west3." — (2024-11-08T15:12:33Z)
jonathan: Suggest we give preferred zones: us-west3-a and us-west3-b. Also include fallback zone us-west2 if capacity blocked here.
liam: Adding fallback. Also want a temp workaround: can we provision 8 A100s now in us-west2 and queue rest in us-west3? What's the cost tradeoff for cross-region egress?
helen: Cross-region egress could hit $0.01–0.02/GB depending on path, but model KV caching will increase traffic if split across regions. For short term we can route inference traffic to region-local endpoints to avoid egress.
sre-oncall: I'll add cluster autoscaler policy to prefer local nodes and set max surge to prevent overprovisioning. Also will create monitoring alert for pod scheduling failures and ephemeral port exhaustion.
maya: GCP asked for committed monthly GPU hours to expedite. I added: 7200 GPU-hours/month, 99.9% SLA needed, expected steady-state QPS 240 r/s across the fleet. Also asked support to attach a quota increase to the project instead of org fallback.
liam: Thanks — can someone paste the gcloud command you used to check regional quotas? I want to monitor.
jonathan: Use this: ```gcloud compute regions describe us-west3 --project=redwood-acme-prod --format=json | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'``` That shows current GPU quota per region.
infra-bot: Case 012345678901234: GCP Support replied — "us-west3-a has limited NVLink capacity; recommended zones: us-west3-b and us-west3-c. To guarantee NVLink please provide preferred zone pairs and complete billing verification." — (2024-11-08T20:03:11Z)
liam: Hmm okay. Preference: primary us-west3-b + us-west3-c, fallback us-west2-a. Maya can you push for TAM to coordinate capacity or provide a temporary burst? This is revenue blocking.
maya: On it. I'm requesting manual capacity check and a temporary quota burst for 30 days. Also looping in our GCP TAM and account rep. Adding contact: tam@google.com (cc'ed in case thread).
gcp-support-bot: Case 012345678901234: Support note added — "Submitted to capacity team for NVLink enablement. ETA 48-72h for confirmation. If capacity insufficient, suggested options: reduce NVLink requirement or split across zones." — (2024-11-09T02:35:00Z)
helen: If they can't enable NVLink we can still run multi-GPU across nodes without NVLink using NCCL over network, but perf drop is ~20-30% for shard sync. Better to avoid if production-critical.
liam: Understood. Keep me posted. I'll hold off customer onboarding until we have confirmation. If we get a 30-day burst it's fine.
maya: I'll post updates here. If GCP stalls >72h we escalate to account manager and legal for contract-backed capacity. Will also create a temporary Dedicated reservation quote with finance as fallback.
jonathan: Finance note: Dedicated reserved capacity estimate — ~ $X/day for 16 A100s (I'll attach spreadsheet). If needed that buys us guaranteed capacity while support resolves.
infra-bot: Reminder: created ticket in internal tracker INFRA-9876 to track provisioning steps, cost approvals, and oncall runbook entries.
liam: Thanks everyone. I'll update acme-ml with the delay and estimated wait. If we hear anything from case 012345678901234, please paste the update here.
gcp-support-bot: Case 012345678901234 comment: "Please provide proof of billing verification to expedite quota. Attach invoice or billing admin authorization." — (2024-11-09T09:14:47Z)
